message: So, the other day I decided to make a fancy dinner and, of course, I forgot my smoke alarm was a little too eager to join the party. There I was, frantically waving a dish towel around like it was a flag of surrender while the smoke filled the kitchen. In the chaos, I realized I had no escape plan—just a panicked dash to the nearest window! It’s funny how we think we’re ready until life throws us a curveball. It got me thinking about the importance of having not just smoke alarms, but also a solid plan in case things go south. Have you ever had a moment that made you rethink your preparedness? I’d love to hear your stories!
